mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_record ( member_id, record_date, mood_level, mood_memo, sleep_level, sleep_memo, meal_level, meal_memo, exercise_level, exercise_memo, social_level, social_memo ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{recordDate}, #{moodLevel}, #{moodMemo}, #{sleepLevel}, #{sleepMemo}, #{mealLevel}, #{mealMemo}, #{exerciseLevel}, #{exerciseMemo}, #{socialLevel}, #{socialMemo} )
mapper.update: UPDATE daily_record SET mood_level = #{moodLevel}, mood_memo = #{moodMemo}, sleep_level = #{sleepLevel}, sleep_memo = #{sleepMemo}, meal_level = #{mealLevel}, meal_memo = #{mealMemo}, exercise_level = #{exerciseLevel}, exercise_memo = #{exerciseMemo}, social_level = #{socialLevel}, social_memo = #{socialMemo} WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND record_date = #{recordDate}
